description: Machine-readable allowlist of locations where 'moneta' identifiers are permitted after the Ola rename. The rename-inventory test (R1) must fail on any 'moneta' occurrence outside these entries, and fail on any stale entry that no longer has a matching occurrence.

policy.rule: Every 'moneta' string in the post-rename tree MUST match exactly one allowlist entry. Unmatched occurrences fail the build. Stale allowlist entries (no matching occurrence) also fail the build.

entries.reason: Legacy schema normalization — SCHEMA_ALIASES mapping table maps old schema identifiers to ola.offload.* canonical form. NOTE: path moves to hooks/core/schema-version.js during R3 extraction.
Tests proving schema alias normalization works for legacy identifiers. NOTE: path moves to tests/schema-alias-completeness.test.cjs.
Secret scanner redaction regex matches both ola_cap_ and moneta_cap_ to prevent old capability handles from leaking into logs. NOTE: path moves to hooks/core/secrets.js during R3 extraction.
Historical transcript parsing — regex /mcp__(ola|moneta)_/ recognizes both new mcp__ola__ and legacy mcp__moneta__ tool calls. NOTE: path moves to hooks/core/assess.js during R3 extraction.
Environment variable legacy detection module — LEGACY_ENV_MAP references all MONETA_* variable names for detection and migration guidance.
Comment in shared.js explaining legacy MONETA_* env var detection. NOTE: path moves to hooks/core/shared.js during R3 extraction.

detectAuthoritativeLegacyStores() flags old ~/.moneta/data/, the moneta@inline plugin-data leak path, and ~/.moneta.migrated-* archives. Function name monetaDataCandidate() and related references are inherent to R2 migration safety. NOTE: path moves to hooks/core/legacy-stores.js during R3 extraction.

R2 regression test exercises the authoritative-vs-archive distinction by constructing fixtures at ~/.moneta/data, moneta@inline, and ~/.moneta.migrated-* paths inside a sandboxed home. The legacy store paths are test fixtures by necessity.

Sentinel lives at ~/.ola-migration/ specifically because it must be a sibling of both ~/.moneta/ and ~/.ola/. Documentation comments and architectural invariant notes reference ~/.moneta/ by necessity.
R2 regression test destroys ~/.moneta/ to verify the sentinel survives. The legacy store path is a test fixture by necessity.

R2 migration CLI. Entire purpose is to read from ~/.moneta/ and ~/.moneta/data/, reference moneta@inline plugin-data leak paths, and port moneta-prefixed variables/records (monetaPayloads, monetaData, moneta_records, etc.) that describe the legacy source side of the migration. Renaming these would obscure which side of the migration a variable represents. NOTE: pattern is broad because the file is fundamentally about porting Moneta.
